text.11:91: They said: O Shu'eyb! We understand not much of that thou tellest, and lo! we do behold thee weak among us. But for thy family, we should have stoned thee, for thou art not strong against us.
text.18:20: For they, if they should come to know of you, will stone you or turn you back to their religion; then ye will never prosper.
text.19:46: He said: Rejectest thou my gods, O Abraham? If thou cease not, I shall surely stone thee. Depart from me a long while!
text.36:18: (The people of the city) said: We augur ill of you. If ye desist not, we shall surely stone you, and grievous torture will befall you at our hands.
text.44:20: And lo! I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord lest ye stone me to death.
